findings.comment: Setback dimensions are provided on the site plan (e.g., 25.0', 21.3', 44.2', 46.9' from buildings to property lines), and dashed lines appear to indicate setback boundaries. However, these lines are not explicitly labeled as 'Setback Lines' or 'Building Setback,' making it ambiguous whether formal setback line designation has been met per requirements for explicit labeling. Additionally, without access to the required MF-2 setback minimums from LDC § 25-2-492, cannot verify that shown distances meet code minimums.

The required setback table from LDC § 25-2-492 for MF-2 district (front yard, rear yard, interior side, street side minimums) is not provided in the submitted documents. Although the site plan shows setback dimensions, cannot verify that these distances meet or exceed the code-required minimums without access to the applicable setback table.

applicableAreas: Site boundary and adjacent SF-3 property
findings.comment: The site is zoned MF-2 (less restrictive than MF-4), and an adjacent SF-3 property exists within the site boundary (Vision confirms 'SF-3' zoning labeled on site plan). Article 10 compatibility standards should apply per § 25-2-1051. However, neither the cover sheet nor the site plan documentation references Article 10, compatibility standards, or the applicability determination. Without explicit documentation of the applicability analysis, cannot verify whether the site's Article 10 applicability has been correctly determined.

applicableAreas: Buildings 6, 7, and 8 (closest to SF-3 property line); structures within 75 feet of SF-3 boundary
findings.comment: Article 10 height limits require: structures < 50 ft from triggering property boundary ≤ 40 ft; 50–74 ft ≤ 60 ft; ≥ 75 ft = base zoning (§ 25-2-1061). Vision analysis confirms Building 8 is 46.9' from SF-3 boundary and Building 6 is 21.3' from SF-3 boundary, both within the 50-ft zone requiring 40-ft max height. Building heights shown (36'-1" max, 33'-4.75" for Buildings 6 and 8) appear numerically compliant. However, the site plan does not depict the distance-based height limit zones (50-ft and 75-ft thresholds) or demonstrate height compliance with the distance bands. Cannot fully verify compliance without these documented height limit zones.

The required separate compatibility exhibit (per ZLU-15.26) must document the approximate location and extent of existing structures on the triggering SF-3 property to verify distance measurements for height limit and buffer compliance. No separate compatibility exhibit is provided in the plan set. Therefore, the location of existing structures on the triggering property cannot be documented or verified.

applicableAreas: Southern property line shared with SF-3 property
findings.comment: Article 10 requires a 25-foot landscaped buffer along the shared triggering property line, or 15 feet if the development site measures less than 75 feet wide from the shared boundary (LDC § 25-2-1062(B)). Vision analysis of both the site plan (Sheet 9) and landscape plan (Sheet 31) confirms: 'No lines, hatched areas, or zones explicitly labeled as a Compatibility Buffer anywhere on the visible site plan' and 'No compatibility buffer zones labeled' on the landscape plan. The required compatibility buffer is not shown, labeled, or dimensioned on either the site plan or landscape plan.

A triggering property under § 25-2-1053 must have 1–3 dwelling units and be zoned SF-5 or more restrictive (including SF-3). The site plan labels the adjacent property as 'SF-3' zoning, but does not identify the specific parcel number (0406100210) or provide documentation of the dwelling unit count. Without clear identification including parcel designation and dwelling unit count, cannot verify the triggering property meets the statutory definition.

applicableAreas: Southern property line shared with SF-3 property (10-foot screening zone from boundary)
findings.comment: The 10-foot screening zone from the shared triggering property line is prohibited from containing vertical structures, parking areas, driveways, or mechanical equipment per § 25-8-700. Vision analysis notes: 'A driveway/parking access lane runs parallel to the southern property line. It is separated from the property line by a landscape strip' with observation that 'while this paved area is visibly close to the southern boundary, there are no explicit dimension lines provided in this specific area to confirm whether the distance is exactly 10 feet or less.' Without dimensioned distances showing the parking/driveway edge location relative to the southern property line, cannot verify compliance with the screening zone prohibition.

applicableAreas: Entire site plan with compatibility exhibit requirements
findings.comment: A separate compatibility exhibit is required to document property boundaries, on-site and off-site zoning boundaries (all triggering properties and applicable combining districts), distances from the triggering property boundary to existing and proposed structures, distances to surface improvements (parking, driveways, drainage features), and the location of existing structures on triggering properties. The sheet index lists 39 total sheets but includes no separate compatibility exhibit. This required documentation is not provided.

applicableAreas: Structures proposed within 75 feet of SF-3 property boundary
findings.comment: Compatibility cross-sections are required to show: (1) the triggering property boundary, (2) distance measurements from the triggering property boundary to proposed structures at the 50-foot and 75-foot thresholds, (3) proposed building heights at each distance band, and (4) elevation of triggering property grade. These cross-sections demonstrate compliance with § 25-2-1061 height limit bands (< 50 ft = 40-ft max; 50–74 ft = 60-ft max). The plan set (39 sheets) includes no cross-section sheets labeled for compatibility analysis. This required documentation is not provided.

applicableAreas: Transformer pad locations on site (northwest, mid-west, east, and south-central areas per electrical plan)
findings.comment: Four transformer pads are shown on the electrical design plan but without any clearance dimensions or specifications per Austin Energy Design Criteria 1.10.4. Vision analysis confirms: 'There are no dimensions shown for clearances around any of the transformer pads on this specific sheet' and 'No labels specifying required clearance distances around the transformer pads.' Required clearances vary by construction type (e.g., 10 feet to hot-stick sides, 5 feet to masonry, 12 feet to non-masonry buildings, etc.). Without dimensioned clearances and identification of building construction types, transformer pad compliance cannot be verified.
